name: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika
description: Grants the user's body rubber properties and the freedom to fight however they can imagine, unleashing Sun God Nika.

name: Mera Mera no Mi (Flame-Flame)
description: Allows the user to create, control, and transform into fire at will.

name: Gura Gura no Mi (Tremor-Tremor)
description: Allows the user to create devastating sea quakes and shockwaves capable of destroying the world.

name: Ope Ope no Mi (Op-Op Fruit)
description: Allows the user to create a spherical realm ('ROOM') where they can manipulate anything, grant eternal youth, or perform miracle operations.

name: Pika Pika no Mi (Glint-Glint)
description: Allows the user to travel at the speed of light, project laser beams, and create light swords.

name: Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu
description: Allows the user to transform into a massive Azure Dragon capable of breathing fire and lifting islands with flame clouds.

name: Hana Hana no Mi (Flower-Flower)
description: Allows the user to sprout duplicates of their body parts on any surface within line of sight.

name: Yomi Yomi no Mi (Revive-Revive)
description: Grants the user a second life after death and the ability to project their soul outside their body with underworld chill.
